personality_one_liner: An incredibly intuitive, highly legible patient companion that feels trustworthy, structured, and completely un-intimidating for users of all digital skill levels.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Touch targets must be strictly >= 48pt. Padding in cards should be `lg` to avoid cramped text.

do's: Use on the bottom tab bar.
Use on sticky headers when scrolling content goes underneath.
Use on the floating 'Agendar Consulta' or 'Tomar Remédio' primary CTA at the bottom of the screen.
dont's: Do not use on data cards, list rows, or form inputs. Keep medical info crisp on solid backgrounds.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Authenticate the patient simply using email and password.

states.error: Inline error above the CTA or standard alert.

screens.layout: Large logo/title at the top, clear large input fields (16pt font inside), huge primary button. 'Esqueci a senha' accessible below CTA.

screens.name: Register
screens.purpose: Onboard a new patient with their basic details.
screens.layout: Scrollable form with clearly labeled fields (Email, Senha, Nome, CPF). Sticky CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provide a quick daily summary of the patient's actionable items (next med, next appointment).

states.loading: Skeleton cards for the top 'Resumo do Dia' section.
states.empty: Illustration of a healthy day, 'Tudo em dia! Nenhum remédio ou consulta hoje.'
states.error: Error loading day's summary with a retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Olá, [Nome]' and avatar. A large 'Resumo do Dia' hero card (tinted `brandTertiary` or `surfaceSecondary`) showing the immediate next action. Below that, quick access tiles for Documentos/Exames.

screens.name: Appointments List
screens.purpose: List upcoming and past medical appointments.

states.empty: 'Nenhuma consulta agendada.' with a primary 'Agendar Agora' button.

screens.layout: Segmented control (Próximas, Histórico). List of cards with Doctor name, Specialty, Date/Time, and Status (Confirmada, Fila de Espera). Sticky FAB or bottom button to schedule.

screens.name: Appointment Detail
screens.purpose: Show details of a specific appointment and allow cancellation.
screens.layout: Doctor's photo (from images) at top, large text for Date/Time. Location map or clinic details. Big 'Cancelar Consulta' button at the bottom (colored warning or outline).

screens.name: Appointment Booking
screens.purpose: Flow to schedule a new appointment.

states.empty: No slots available for chosen date.

screens.layout: Step-by-step: Select Specialty -> Select Doctor -> Select Date/Time. Large tap areas for dates. Sticky confirmation button at bottom.

screens.name: Medications List
screens.layout: Horizontal calendar strip at the top. Below, a vertical timeline of medications for the selected day. Med cards have a large 'Tomar' check button.

screens.name: Medication Detail
screens.purpose: Show info about a medication and its stock.
screens.layout: Large pill icon/photo. Dosage, frequency, and a stock progress bar (e.g., 10/30 pills left). Low stock shows a warning banner.

screens.name: Medication Take Dose
screens.purpose: Anti-fraud camera capture screen to confirm taking medication.
screens.layout: Full-screen camera view with a large circular shutter button. Overlay text: 'Tire uma foto do remédio'. Confirmed state shows a success checkmark.

screens.name: Exams List
screens.purpose: List available medical documents and ready exams.
screens.layout: List of distinct cards (Exame de Sangue, Receita Médica). Tag indicating 'Pronto' or 'Em análise'.

screens.name: Exam Detail
screens.purpose: View a specific exam or prescription.
screens.layout: Metadata at the top (Doctor, Date). A large viewer area for the document or text summary. 'Baixar PDF' primary action.

screens.name: Emergency Card
screens.layout: Distinct colored card (brandSecondary / Green) rotated horizontally or taking full screen. Shows Blood Type, Allergies, and Emergency Contacts prominently.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Manage personal info and app settings.
screens.layout: Avatar and Name. List of standard settings rows (Dados Pessoais, Contato de Emergência, Notificações, Sair) with icons in `brandTertiary` tinted squares.

medicine_pills.alt: Pink pill organizer with colorful tablets

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Green (#00A650) and Blue (#0066CC) color palette requested by the user, representing health and trust (SUS context).
Ensure touch targets are strictly >= 44pt (ideally larger for this demographic) and text size is boosted. The base text size should be 16pt, not 14pt.
Do NOT use pure black text. Use the provided onSurface (#0F172A) for high contrast while reducing eye strain.
When a button is floating over scrollable content, ensure it has a glassmorphic background to maintain visual hierarchy without completely blocking content.
In the 'Tomar Remédio' flow, implement the camera capture screen as an anti-fraud measure, ensuring it is a full-screen view with a huge, unmistakable capture button.
Do not use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Implement 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for superior readability and a cleaner, friendly aesthetic.
